Separate Stereo VRS maps per eye, an AMD CPU-cache preference and a tidier Settings page. **Huge thanks to Markus Stahl** for the VRS optimizations, autoload test fix, CPU scheduling contribution and continued help.

### Changes

- **Stereo VRS:** Keep a shading-rate map per eye, regenerate it only when that eye's focus changes, and upload only when its 16×16 tiles change. Reuse map storage and optimize rows outside the sharp area. Diagnostics include `mapUploads`.
- **AMD CPU preference:** **Settings > Prefer the 3D V-Cache CCD (AMD X3D)** is enabled by default. On supported dual-CCD AMD systems with two complete, clearly asymmetric L3 domains, it requests the larger-cache CCD using Windows process-default CPU sets. It skips other or ambiguous topologies, unsupported processor groups, failed queries and existing process affinity/default CPU sets. Explicit thread policies retain Windows precedence.
- **Local preference:** The CPU setting applies on next launch in Quad Views and Stereo VRS, including Steam automatic startup. Shared profiles do not change it. Enable diagnostics to see `cpu cache affinity:` decisions.
- **Launcher:** Rename Setup to **Settings**, move the green focus-outline toggle there and remove Outer smoothing. Legacy smoothing values are ignored; launcher starts explicitly disable the filter.
- **Test reliability:** Give autoload fixtures unique paths, wait for released image locks and retry cleanup with bounds. Cleanup preserves pre-existing files.
- **Manual diagnostic:** Include `tools/check-hardware-vrs.cmd` and a versioned NVIDIA VRS check. Close LMU before running it; normal builds compile the diagnostic without executing a physical-GPU workload.

### Performance expectations

No new in-game CPU frametime improvement has been measured for 0.5.4. The **1–1.5 ms reduction** I reported for **0.5.1** was observed in my own benchmark scenario; it is not a measurement of these new changes.

VRS caching reduces map-generation and upload work. The CPU preference may help on suitable dual-CCD X3D systems, but choosing one CCD also reduces the cores available to other game work. Compare on/off in the same scene. Quad Views still needs sufficient CPU headroom. SPS/MVR is not enabled.

### Downloads and updating

Choose **`LMU-Quad-View-Mod-0.5.4-Setup-x64.exe`** or **`LMU-Quad-View-Mod-0.5.4.zip`**. Release binaries are signed and timestamped; `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers both downloads.

Close LMU and the old launcher before updating. Preserve `launcher-settings.xml` and `profiles` when moving a portable package. Open the new launcher, save your settings and run **Settings > Install / update automatic startup** to update Steam startup to the new binaries.

### Validation

Native MSVC tests passed, including 80 OpenXR scenarios, 2,400 map-equivalence cases and 166 CPU-policy checks. Launcher layout/slider tests, 30 consecutive autoload verification runs and installer validation also passed. Physical NVIDIA per-eye behavior and in-game gains from the X3D preference still need validation on the relevant systems.
